notes.title: Play the demo for my upcoming point&click adventure "The Jester and the Madman"
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, 



just wanted to let you know that the sequel to "The Curse of the Old Gods" now has a demo available to play. The full release of "The Jester and the Madman" will be on 21st of October.  

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3893670/The_Jester_and_the_Madman/"][/dynamiclink]

"The Jester and the Madman, a sequel to Curse of the Old Gods, is a point-and-click adventure with a 90s-style digitized art aesthetic, steeped in Lovecraftian horror. Solve puzzles, uncover a vast conspiracy, and descend into a world of cults, paranoia, and creeping madness."



Hope you'll check it out. 

   

Cheers,   

Tim[/p]

notes.title: New Update 1.3 introducing Steam Achievements
notes.content:
I've just released a new update for the Movie Tycoon Simulator.

You can now unlock a variety of achievements and a few [b]secrets[/b] in the game. Prove that you're a real Movie Mogul and try to unlock all of them! :)

Keep those movies coming,
 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.content:
Hello,
just released another small update fixing a bug with movie marketing and rebalancing the quality of your own movies in later stages of the game.

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone and a Happy New Year! :)

I've just released another update to the game with a few bug fixes. Notably for some of you your own movies didn't generate any revenue (or worse negative revenue)... that's fixed now. 

Cheers and have fun playing!
 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.1.9
notes.content:
Another small update before the holidays.

Again with a bunch of bug-fixes and small new feature: 
The game will automatically pause while you are in any menu (You can turn this off in the settings if you don't want that).

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Update to 1.1.8
notes.content:
Hello fellow Tycoons!

I've just released an update to the game:
-Fixed several exceptions and crashes
-Screens now correctly update when a day passes
-Fixed the error screen ːsteamfacepalmː

If you encounter any more problems with the game, please let me know! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update 1.1.7
notes.content:
I've just released a new update for the Movie Tycoon Simulator. It adds an option to the main menu to reset your game and start over.

There are also a few other little changes like pressing the escape key will now bring you to the main menu instead of instantly quitting the game. ːsteamhappyː
